svg.title: SpotZⁱ — ClaimShield Nexus tech stack
svg.text: Open-source, runs on one laptop, no external AI required. Versions are the ones the shipped models were trained and tested with.
ES2020 modules, no framework, no build step
glossy glass theme, responsive grid, print layout
TF-IDF word + char n-grams → logistic regression
CSV tables · X12 837 · documents with SHA-256
HttpOnly SameSite cookies · CSP · origin check
CI on every push · pinned constraints.txt
evaluation only, never used for detection
Algorithms rules engine (9 rules + analyst rules) · Isolation Forest · graph analytics & Louvain communities · gradient-boosted case-mix twin · care-pathway sequence model
change-point detection · Jensen–Shannon code-mix divergence · CUSUM temporal evolution · discrete-time hazard forecast · one-sided logistic fusion · MAP learning from decisions
